Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 5 minutes Number of Servings: 8 Ingredients 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt 1 teaspoon vanilla 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon 1 teaspoon brown sugar Directions In a bowl, combine yogurt, vanilla, cinnamon, and brown sugar. Mix well. Serve with sliced apples or other fruit. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
